Unofficial 3D model, not affiliated with ANA, Boeing, GE or the seat makers JAMCO, Safran, ZIM and Recaro. Rows, letters, seat directions, galleys, lavatories and the bar follow ANA's "new 212 seats" 777-300ER map (THE Suite / THE Room), flown on some SFO–NRT (NH7/8) rotations. Built against ANA's 41 official photos of this cabin: colours sampled from them; fabric, wood and carpet patterns are small tiles cut from them. Cross-section and windows from Boeing's airport planning document, seat sizes from maker statements, details from trip-report photos; door spacing derived from ANA's row pitches. Approximated: rear galleys, lavatories and the bar in service (no photos found), ceilings at most doors, the fabric pattern per seat, mood-lighting levels, PY / Economy shade colour, suite wall height. Sources: ANA seat map · ANA seat pages F, J, PY, Y · ANA 2019 release · Boeing D6-58329-2 · Safran Fusio (RGN) · TPG THE Room · OMAAT · Business Traveller · MileLion THE Suite · The Alviator PY · SANspotter PY
